name: test
description: Use this skill when deciding what to test, at which layer, and in what order — before writing the tests themselves. Covers the test pyramid, TDD red-green-refactor workflow, and what to skip. For the mechanics of writing tests, see test-unit and test-e2e.
when: When deciding what to test and at which layer — strategy above test-unit and test-e2e
do-not-use-when: Writing the actual test code — use unit-test or e2e-test
Debugging a failing test — use debugging
